parameters.description: Total population size for the season (England). Used in force of infection λ(t)=β I(t)/N.
Discrete time step length (a quarter of a day).
Transmission rate parameter in force of infection λ(t)=β I(t)/N (rate at which new infections occur given a contact).
Daily rate of progression through exposed stages (E₁→E₂ and E₂→I₁). Paper assumes known; implies mean incubation period d_L = 2/σ.
Daily rate of progression through infectious stages (I₁→I₂ and I₂→R). Paper assumes known; implies mean infectious period d_I = 2/γ.
Probability of ICU/HDU admission given infection (used in observational model; not a transmission flow in the SEIR system).
Mean time from infection to ICU/HDU admission (Gamma waiting time in observational model).
Variance of time from infection to ICU/HDU admission (Gamma waiting time in observational model).
Negative binomial dispersion parameter for weekly ICU/HDU admission counts (observational model).
Force of infection at time t, assuming homogeneous mixing; I_tot is total infectious (I₁+I₂).
Total infectious individuals at time t.
